name: arxiv-api
description: arXiv e-print repository wrapper — full-text search with the arXiv query syntax, paper metadata lookup by arXiv id (search, list, get), and Atom feed parsing.

arxiv.v1.ArxivService/SearchPapers.name: search-papers
arxiv.v1.ArxivService/SearchPapers.description: Search arXiv e-prints using the arXiv query syntax and return paged results.

arxiv.v1.ArxivService/GetPaper.name: get-paper
arxiv.v1.ArxivService/GetPaper.description: Fetch metadata for a single arXiv paper by id (optionally versioned).

arxiv.v1.ArxivService/ListPapers.name: list-papers
arxiv.v1.ArxivService/ListPapers.description: Fetch metadata for several arXiv papers by id and report any missing ids.
